nina: Dropping a new take on the roles page — compact rows with a single expander (chevron) that reveals a 2-line permission summary + keyboard shortcut to preview (press 'p' when a row is focused). Figma: https://figma.com/file/ROLE_PREVIEW_NEW omar: Nice. Two quick things: 1) prefer a single action per row for keyboard users (chevron), not multiple tabbable chips; 2) we need a clear microcopy for the SSO control. 'Enforce SSO' reads aggressive. How about 'Require SSO for org sign-in'? lucy: +1 on the SSO copy. Also: for the preview popover please put a non-interactive summary first, then actions (Edit, Clone) so screen readers don't get overloaded. Use aria-role="status" or an aria-live region for the summary so JAWS/VoiceOver read it when it opens. chao: Implementation thought: should we persist audit log filters in sessionStorage or via URL params? URL params make back/forward work which seems nicer. We can keep a short set: start/end, actor id, severity. Avoid dumping huge JSON. sam: UX nit on the chevron: add an accessible label that changes based on state, e.g., `aria-label="Show permissions for Billing Manager"` and toggle `aria-expanded`. Also add a tiny keyboard hint tooltip: "Press P to preview" when the row gets focus. nina: Love the shortcut idea. But be careful with single-letter shortcuts — conflict risk. Maybe require focus in component or show shortcut only when component receives focus. Also provide a settings toggle to disable shortcuts for users who prefer not to have them. omar: On the invite drawer: there was a recent bug where nested role detail panels didn't return focus to the drawer header. We should trap focus in overlays and close in nested order (Esc closes detail -> Esc closes drawer). Also ensure Shift+Tab works back to the header. QA flagged this. lucy: For screen reader copy, propose: when a preview opens announce: "Permissions preview for Billing Manager. Can view invoices, manage refunds, view org billing. Press Escape to close." Keep it concise — avoid long sentences. Use polite aria-live so it's not noisy. chao: About persisting audit filters: URL params + shallow routing is my vote. That fixes back/forward and is easy to bookmark. We should add a small toast when filters are applied that includes a copy link icon: "Filters applied — copy link to share current view". That helps incident postmortems. qa-bot: QA reproduce steps for focus trap: Open org settings > Invite > open role details > Tab until focus escapes. Reproducible on Chrome/Win. Logged QA-8976. Also audit filter reset repro is attached to same ticket. sam: Microcopy suggestion for invite CTA — dynamic vs static: dynamic helps clarity. Proposed patterns: default "Invite users"; when count known "Invite 3 users and assign roles"; when single role selected "Invite and assign Billing Manager". Keeps expectations clear. nina: Action items live here: - switch SSO label to "Require SSO for org sign-in" + helper line "Existing sessions remain signed in; new sign-ins will require your IdP." Put helper in aria-describedby (omar) - make one tabbable chevron per row with aria-expanded + aria-controls and keyboard 'p' preview (sam + nina) - preview popover: non-interactive summary first, then actions; announce with polite aria-live and short SR copy (lucy) - trap focus in invite drawer and close nested panels in order; confirm Shift+Tab behavior (eng ticket linked to QA-8976) - persist audit filters via URL params + add "Copy link" toast affordance (chao) - disable-single-letter-shortcut setting option in user prefs (nina) chao: Quick ARIA example for the chevron button I pasted into the Figma notes: ```
Can view invoices, manage refunds
``` lucy: That looks good. For the popover role use `role="dialog" aria-modal="false"` because it's not a blocking modal, then trap focus if we add interactive elements inside. omar: I will update the SSO copy in the component library and add the helper text in the form schema so it's available for aria-describedby. sam: I'll prototype the dynamic invite CTA in the component playground and post a small snippet for the copy logic. qa-bot: QA ticket QA-8976 created and assigned to eng-ux for the focus-trap + audit filter persistence. Please link PRs back to this ticket. nina: Can design deliver a compact screen with chevron states, keyboard hint, and the toast mock for copy-link by EOD? Eng needs these to estimate. Also add a quick accessibility checklist in the figma notes (focus order, aria labels, polite live regions, contrast). design-bot: Created PROD-5620: "Roles compact: chevron preview, keyboard shortcut, SSO helper copy, audit link toast" and assigned to design + eng-ux. chao: One more ask: when persisting audit filters, please avoid including PII in the URL. Use IDs only. We'll encrypt sensitive params if needed. nina: Great flag. We'll ensure actor ids are opaque and not emails. Thanks all — will follow-up in PROD-5620. :sparkles:
